description: A professional is relocating to Singapore for a new job. They need to learn about work visa, housing, and cultural adjustment.

user_profile.context: Starting in two months, needs to prepare everything from scratch

fact_sheet.fact: Alex Chen's Employment Pass (EP) application number is EP-2024-881729, submitted by his employer, Nexus Analytics.
The In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter for Alex Chen's EP is valid for a single entry into Singapore until October 15, 2024.
An appointment for Alex Chen's biometrics and EP card issuance is scheduled for September 5, 2024, at 10:30 AM at the MOM Services Centre - Hall C.
Priya Sharma (priya.sharma@nexusanalytics.sg, +65 9123 4567) is the HR Business Partner at Nexus Analytics managing Alex Chen's relocation.
Alex Chen's first day of work at Nexus Analytics is September 2, 2024, starting at 9:00 AM SGT.
On his first day, Alex Chen must bring his original passport, a printed copy of the IPA letter, and the signed employment contract to the office.
Nexus Analytics has engaged 'GlobalMove SG' (contact: Ken Tan, ken.tan@globalmovesg.com) to assist with home-finding and school registration.
Nexus Analytics provides 14 days of temporary accommodation at the 'Orchard Park Suites', located at 15 Claymore Drive, Singapore 229598.
Alex Chen will receive a one-time relocation allowance of S$7,500 to cover initial housing costs like security deposit and agent fees.
The recommended housing portal for finding long-term rentals is SGHomeFind.com, which has a partnership with Nexus Analytics for verified listings.
A 2-bedroom, 700 sq ft HDB flat at Block 450, Toa Payoh Lorong 6, #12-188, is listed for rent at S$3,200 per month.
The standard security deposit for a rental property in Singapore is two months' rent for a 24-month lease, payable upon signing the Tenancy Agreement.
The standard lease tenure for private apartments and HDB flats is 24 months, with a diplomatic clause applicable after 12 months.
To open a bank account in Singapore, such as a 'Merlion Financial Global Currency Account', Alex Chen needs his passport, Employment Pass (or IPA letter), and proof of residential address.
'SingaTelco' offers a 1Gbps fibre broadband plan for S$45.90 per month on a 24-month contract, which includes free router installation.
To set up an electricity account, Alex Chen must register with SP Group at spgroup.com.sg using his SingPass, which can be created after the EP is issued.
Salary from Nexus Analytics will be credited to Alex Chen's designated bank account on the 25th of each month.
A recommended SIM-only mobile plan is the 'CircleLife 50GB' plan for S$18 per month, which operates on a no-contract basis and can be ordered online.
An EZ-Link public transport card can be purchased for S$12 (S$5 non-refundable card cost, S$7 stored value) at any MRT station TransitLink Ticket Office.
The MRT commute from Toa Payoh Station (NS19) to Raffles Place Station (NS26/EW14), near the office, takes approximately 18 minutes and costs S$1.48.
The 'Grab' app is the primary ride-hailing service; an off-peak trip from Toa Payoh to the Nexus Analytics office costs approximately S$16.
The Nexus Analytics office is located at 1 Raffles Quay, North Tower, Level 35, Singapore 048583.
Standard working hours at Nexus Analytics are from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with a one-hour lunch break.
As a Data Scientist, Alex Chen will be joining the 'Predictive Modelling' team, reporting to the Head of Data Science, Dr. Evelyn Reed.
A guide to Singaporean workplace etiquette is available on the company intranet at intranet.nexusanalytics.sg/guides/SG_Culture_Guide_v2.pdf.
The 'Singapore Professional Expats' group on LinkedIn, moderated by GlobalMove SG, is a recommended resource for networking and local advice.
Alex Chen can register for a SingPass account at any SingPost outlet once his Employment Pass card is issued, which is required for most government digital services.
For non-emergency medical needs, Alex Chen can visit the 'Raffles Medical' clinic at Raffles City Shopping Centre, which is part of the company's 'Aetna' health insurance network.
